faq.title: Quick questions
faq.q1: How is Kasa different from SalonGo?
faq.a1: Kasa is only the till and the books, on one computer, paid once. For appointments, online booking or phones, choose SalonGo.
faq.a2: Yes. Kasa takes payments and prints receipts offline and sends EET once you are back online.
faq.a3: On your salon's computer. Kasa makes an encrypted backup every day to a USB drive or a Google Drive folder.
faq.a4: 1 licence is for 1 computer. Message support and we move the licence to the new one.
